contenu:
name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      agent_pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

parameters:
- name: isDebugBuild
  displayName: 'Build in DEBUG Mode'
  type: boolean
  default: false

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: downtime-ui

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      debugBuild: ${{ parameters.isDebugBuild }}
      repository: mesx/downtime-ui

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01

/**
 * Convert a language code to an ISO country code used for flag icons.
 * @param code language code (e.g. 'en', 'en_US')
 * @returns lowercase country code suitable for flag CSS classes (e.g. 'us'), or
 * an empty string when no mapping is available
 */
export function langCodeToCountry(code: string): string {
  if (!code) return '';
  const normalized = String(code).replace('_', '-').toUpperCase();
  const mapEntries: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['AF', 'za'],
    ['AR', 'sa'],
    ['BN', 'bd'],
    ['CS', 'cz'],
    ['DA', 'dk'],
    ['DE', 'de'],
    ['EN', 'us'],
    ['ES', 'es'],
    ['FA', 'ir'],
    ['FI', 'fi'],
    ['FR', 'fr'],
    ['HI', 'in'],
    ['HU', 'hu'],
    ['ID', 'id'],
    ['IT', 'it'],
    ['JA', 'jp'],
    ['KO', 'kr'],
    ['MS', 'my'],
    ['NL', 'nl'],
    ['NO', 'no'],
    ['PL', 'pl'],
    ['PT', 'pt'],
    ['RO', 'ro'],
    ['RU', 'ru'],
    ['SV', 'se'],
    ['SW', 'ke'],
    ['TH', 'th'],
    ['TR', 'tr'],
    ['VI', 'vn'],
    ['ZH', 'cn'],
  ];
  const map: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(mapEntries);
  if (map[normalized]) return map[normalized];
  const prefix = normalized.split('-')[0];
  return map[prefix] ?? '';
}

/**
 * Build the flag CSS class for a language code.
 * @param code language code
 * @returns a flag CSS class like 'fi fi-us' or an empty string when not found
 */
export function getLanguageFlag(code: string): string {
  const cc = langCodeToCountry(code ?? '');
  return cc ? `fi fi-${cc}` : '';
}

/**
 * Resolve the human-readable language name from a language code.
 * @param code language code to resolve
 * @returns the language display name when found, otherwise returns the
 * original code value
 */
export function getLanguageName(code: string): string {
  const lang = languages.find(
    (l) =>
      l.code === code.toUpperCase() || l.code.startsWith(code.toUpperCase()),
  );
  return lang ? lang.name : code;
}

export type LanguageMap = Record<string, string>;
